answer: A scarcer defense is exclusive-quota assignment. Each epoch, the network issues a fixed set of non-transferable resource quotas, such as one copper hauling lane, one shale sampling lease, or one bridge inspection window, and every identity may hold at most one quota per cycle. Rewards flow only through quotas, so an operator spawning clones gains nothing: the quotas are capped and a clone holds one just like the original, splitting the same total. Extra identities cost registration fees and compute while multiplying nothing, which makes mass creation a pure loss.
